profile.reading:
This record sits in the centre of Sarzana, a town of about 21,000 people in the province of La Spezia in eastern Liguria, and it is named ACI Sede si Sarzana. Sede is the Italian word for a seat or office, and the wording reads as a slightly garbled rendering of ACI's Sarzana office. ACI is the Automobile Club d'Italia, the country's national motoring organisation and a public body, which maintains provincial automobile clubs and a network of local delegations that handle vehicle registration paperwork through the public vehicle register, road tax payments, ownership transfers, licence formalities and membership and roadside assistance services. A front counter office of that kind runs ordinary business systems and at most a communications cabinet. It is not a data centre.

The map record supports that reading rather than the tag. The OpenStreetMap node was created on 13 July 2022 by an Italian mapper in a 150 change edit titled changes to Sarzana, made in the iD editor with Bing imagery and a GPX track, which is the signature of someone walking a town and recording what they see. The node carries exactly two tags, the name and telecom=data_center. There is no address, no operator, no website, no opening hours. It has never been edited since. In the same changeset, and with the very next object identifier, the same mapper added an IREN water utility counter at Via XX Settembre 63 and tagged it correctly as office=water_utility. So the mapper was adding a run of public facing offices in the town centre and, on this one, reached for a preset from the telecom group instead of an office preset.

The coordinates place the point in Piazza Guido Jurgens, next to Sarzana railway station, in a square surrounded by car parks, a taxi rank, a war memorial and a bar, opposite the municipal registry office and the local police command. That is a civic and retail square in the historic centre, not an industrial or utility site. Automobile Club La Spezia publishes its own address as via Costantini 18 in La Spezia and directs enquiries about local delegations to a map based finder, and no Sarzana street address for ACI could be confirmed this session, so this registry does not assert one.

The value of keeping this row is that it shows how one preset click on a counter office in a Ligurian market town becomes a data centre in every dataset that harvests the telecom=data_center tag without review.
profile.research_note: Rewritten 2026-09-05 from 740 characters of unsourced inference to a documented mistag page. New evidence: node 9884991527 is a single version object created 2022-07-13 by mapper nilogian in changeset 123560810 (150 changes, iD 2.21.1, Italian locale, imagery Bing Maps Aerial plus a GPX data file, comment Modifiche a Sarzana), carrying only name and telecom=data_center. Decisive corroboration is node 9884991528, the very next id, created in the same changeset by the same mapper as IREN with office=water_utility, later given the address Via XX Settembre 63 Sarzana, which shows the mapper was adding a sequence of public facing counter offices. An OSM map bbox call around the coordinates puts the point in Piazza Guido Jurgens by Sarzana railway station, among car parks, a taxi rank, a bar, the Anagrafe Comune di Sarzana and the municipal police command. laspezia.aci.it publishes the provincial club address as via Costantini 18 in La Spezia and offers only a map based delegation finder, so no Sarzana address is asserted. Nominatim search for ACI Sarzana returns nothing. WebSearch quota exhausted this session.
